title: Roster Cluster Commit Response
description: Response from POST /acx/v1/roster/clusters/{cluster_id}/commit. Bound person identity is present for both create and rebind outcomes.

person_id.description: Bound local person id, or null when unbound.

person_uuid.description: Bound person UUID for both create and rebind outcomes, or null when unbound.

person_name.description: Display name of the bound person, or null when unbound.

updated_at.description: Server timestamp for the cluster update.
